title: Privacy Policy for Arrow Puzzle
content:
Arrow Puzzle is published by **NishArc Studios**. This Privacy Policy explains how information is handled when you use the game.

**App:** Arrow Puzzle  
**Android package:** com.nisharc.arrowpuzzle  
**Effective date:** 7 October 2026  
**Last updated:** 7 October 2026

## 1. Information collected by the game

Arrow Puzzle does not collect or transmit personal information, device identifiers, advertising identifiers, usage analytics, crash reports or location data to the developer. The game does not require an account or sign-in.

The game does not request access to your contacts, photos, camera or microphone. Gameplay works offline.

## 2. Information stored on your device

To restore your progress and preferences, the game saves the following on your device:

- Your highest unlocked level
- Your level completion count
- Sound effects preference
- Vibration preference
- Light or dark theme preference

These values are used only to provide normal game functionality. Arrow Puzzle does not upload them to developer-controlled servers or use them for advertising, profiling or marketing.

Android device backups may include app preferences according to your device backup settings. Arrow Puzzle does not operate its own backup service. Device backups are managed by your device and backup provider under their own settings and policies.

## 3. Advertising, purchases and data sharing

Arrow Puzzle does not contain advertising SDKs, analytics SDKs, tracking tools or real-money in-app purchases. The game does not sell, rent or share gameplay data or personal information with advertisers or data brokers.

Google Play may process information when you download, review or manage the app according to [Google's Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy). That processing is separate from the game's offline operation.

## 4. Retention, deletion and your choices

Your progress and preferences remain on your device until you reset the relevant values, clear app data or uninstall the game.

- **Settings > Reset progress** resets your unlocked level and completion count. It preserves sound, vibration and theme preferences.
- Sound, vibration and theme can be changed individually in Settings.
- Clearing the app's storage through Android settings removes all locally stored game preferences and progress.
- Uninstalling normally removes local app data. A device backup may restore saved preferences when you reinstall; manage or remove backups through your device backup settings.

The game does not maintain online player accounts or a remote gameplay database, so there is no server-side player account to delete.

## 5. Support communications

If you contact us by email, we receive the email address, message and any information you choose to include. We use that information to respond to your question or resolve your support request, and retain it only as needed to handle the request and meet applicable obligations.

Support email is separate from the game. Arrow Puzzle does not send messages or support data automatically. You can request deletion of support correspondence by contacting the address below, subject to any applicable retention requirements.

## 6. Children's privacy

The game does not ask players for personal information and does not collect personal information from children or other players. If you believe a child has provided personal information through a support email, contact us so we can address the request.

## 7. Changes to this policy

If the game's functionality or data practices change, we will update this policy and its last-updated date. The policy is also available inside the game under **Settings > Privacy policy**.

## 8. Contact us

For questions or requests about this policy:

- **Developer / publisher:** NishArc Studios
- **Email:** [nishants.robocircuits@gmail.com](mailto:nishants.robocircuits@gmail.com)
- **App:** Arrow Puzzle
- **Android package:** com.nisharc.arrowpuzzle
